expectations.text: 主术语用 Shunt release（含大小写变体 Shunt Release），不以北美 Shunt trip 或禁用 shunt opening release / Excitation release 作为主术语
expectations.evidence: Body L5: "**Shunt Release**"; Table L23: "采用 IEC 60947-2 标准术语，避免美标/UL 体系常见的 shunt trip".

expectations.text: 闭合电磁铁用 Track 1 样本语体 Closing release（可括注 closing coil），不用 Track 2 Closed electromagnet 或禁用 Closing electromagnet / Close electromagnet
expectations.evidence: Body L9: "Both the closing release and shunt release"; Table L24: "闭合电磁铁 | Closing release".

expectations.text: 钥匙锁用 Track 1 样本语体 ACB Key Lock (KLC)（或 ACB Key Lock / Circuit-breaker key lock），不用 Track 2 Keys and locks (KL) 或直译 Body key lock
expectations.evidence: Body L11: "**Breaker-Mounted Keylock**"; Table L28: "断路器本体钥匙锁 | Breaker-Mounted Keylock" — misses required Track 1 term "ACB Key Lock (KLC)" / "Circuit-breaker key lock".

expectations.text: 开孔工具用样本语体 hole saw / panel hole saw 或 hole punch，不用说明书语体 hole opener
expectations.evidence: Body L13: "using a hole cutter"; Table L29: "开孔器 | hole cutter" — does not use required catalogue idiom "hole saw" / "hole punch".

expectations.text: 遵循 IEC 60947-2:2024 英式拼写与连字符规范：正文统一使用连字符 circuit-breaker（非无连字符 circuit breaker），且通电用词采用 -ize 拼写（pulse-energized / pulse energization，非 energis*）
expectations.evidence: Body L6: "Enables remote opening of the circuit breaker." — uses unhyphenated "circuit breaker" instead of IEC 60947-2:2024 hyphenated "circuit-breaker".

expectations.text: 保留 t1 用不小于/≥（not less than 200 ms / ≥ 200 ms）与 t2 用大于/>（greater than 15 s / more than 15 s / > 15 s）的不对称边界，未统一为同一个符号
expectations.evidence: Body L9: "pulse duration t₁ ≥ 200 ms and an energization interval t₂ > 15 s"; L35 explicitly distinguishes ≥ vs >.

expectations.text: 数字与单位之间严格有单个半角空格（50 ms / 200 ms / 15 s / 28 mm），无粘连写法
expectations.evidence: Body L8-9, L13: "≤ 50 ms", "≥ 200 ms", "> 15 s", "Ø28 mm" — all number-unit pairs have a single half-width space.

expectations.text: 显式说明原文未提供额定控制电源电压的具体电压值，未编造任何电压数值
expectations.evidence: No statement in L17-41 acknowledging that the rated control supply voltage value is absent from source and was not fabricated (L26 only notes "可简写为 70%–110% Us").
